Questions about business analysis coaching

Do I need a technical background to become a business analyst?

No. Many business analysts come from operations, customer service, finance, HR or project roles. What matters is understanding how a business works, asking good questions and writing clear requirements. Coaching helps you translate the experience you already have into BA language.

How much does business analyst coaching cost?

The first 30-minute call is free. A one-hour 1:1 session is AED 400.

Is coaching available outside the UAE?

Yes. Coaching is based in Dubai and runs online for clients worldwide.

Start with a free 30-minute call

No obligation. You'll leave with a clear picture of your next step in business analysis.
